authors: Jeffery C. Seitz, James G. Blencoe
title: The CO2-H2O system. I. Experimental determination of volumetric properties at 400 C, 10-100 MPa
experimental_method: Flow-through vibrating-tube densimeter calibrated with He, Ar and H2O standards; densities of pure CO2 and CO2-H2O mixtures (0.1 mole-fraction steps) at 400 C and 9.94-99.93 MPa.
uncertainties_stated: P +-0.02 MPa, T +-0.05 C, density +-0.0005 g/cm3 (low-density) to +-0.0010 g/cm3 (high-density mixtures); Vex uncertainties tabulated.
quality_remarks: Authors find poor agreement with earlier published mixture densities and EoS-calculated Vex. Vex uncertainties exceed 4 cm3/mol at 9.94 MPa. Temperature scale not stated. 11 PDF pages; paper is complete (no foreign articles).
